## How I tested it
- [ ] `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Tried it in demo mode (`./run.sh --demo`) if it touches the UI or sending
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (phone + desktop)

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, `.db` files or real phone numbers/emails
- [ ] Safety defaults unchanged (approval before send, limits, sending hours, opt-out)
- [ ] README / docs / CHANGELOG updated if behaviour changed
